content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Research Associate / Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for hiring eligible candidates on contractual positions based in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has advertised vacancies for the position of Research Associate / Project Associate under advertisement number HRED/C-1362.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate / Project Associate post in the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the IIT Roorkee Research Associate / Project Associate recruitment is 8 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through Email. No online portal submission or offline postal submission is required for this specific recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must possess an M. Tech or B Tech degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Hydropower Engineering from a recognized institute or university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate / Project Associate post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates applying for these positions at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be strictly based on their performance in the Interview and subsequent Document Verification process conducted by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can visit the official IIT Roorkee website at https://www.iitr.ac.in or check the important links section of this article to access the notification details.
